name: Shefardy Rodistant
original_name: シェファルディ・ローディスタント
source:
Being the head of the maids, Rudy is an excellent maid. She happens to have a long history with the mansion's landlord, [url=/c105726]Meliagris[/url], even rumored to be his ex-lover. For an unknown reason Shefardy wishes to subdue [url=/c105716]Mina Amamiya[/url], and is one of the first to call her "Irregular".

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
